fieldManual.fmPanel.bottomCornerSettings: (bottom corner): settings ⚙, tackle zones, sprite style, skill display, 🏟️ stadium visibility, 🎬 Auto Director, and the 🐞 bug report. Display and camera only — no game actions live there.
fieldManual.fmPanel.bottomRightThePlay: (bottom right): the play-by-play with the real dice. Tabs flip to Chat and both Rosters.
fieldManual.fmPanel.endTurnLivesOn: End Turn lives on the scoreboard
fieldManual.fmPanel.everyActionRidesOne: Every action rides one of six rails. Two gestures carry everything:
fieldManual.fmPanel.everythingRidesThePi: Everything rides the pitch — one camera, one board, every panel floats over it. Drag them where you like.
fieldManual.fmPanel.loadsTheDemoMatch: Loads the demo match and walks the HUD with a gold arrow — no connection needed.
fieldManual.fmPanel.neverInAMenu: , never in a menu. Press it with players still fresh and it asks first.
fieldManual.fmPanel.nuffleDemandsTheatre: Nuffle demands theatre. Fan factor, weather, the coin toss and inducements each get their beat before the boot hits the ball — and the big moments land as centre-pitch banners (yes, the Halfling Master Chef announces his thefts in gold).
fieldManual.fmPanel.orTheArrowKeys: or the arrow keys, or drag; scroll to zoom.
fieldManual.fmPanel.theActionMenuShows: The action menu shows only what's legal right now — nothing is greyed out, it's present or absent.
fieldManual.fmPanel.theGoldHaloMarks: the gold halo marks the player being activated; the ring under each player is white until they act, then grey. Skill icons ride over heads (or as text markers at the feet) — tune them in Settings → Display → Skill display config.
fieldManual.fmPanel.tracksTheBallAnd: tracks the ball and the acting player. Toggle it off for a calm camera: pan with
fieldManual.fmPanel.yoursOrTheirsFor: — yours or theirs — for their card: stats, skills, SPP.
fieldManual.rails.beforeMovingLeftClick: Before moving, left-click an adjacent standing enemy: the dice preview appears with Confirm Block on the bar. Click the same enemy again to throw it. Right-click the target for Stab, Chainsaw and the other flavours.
fieldManual.rails.declareFromTheMenu: Declare from the menu and the range template arms itself — hover for the throw 🎯 and catch 🧤 numbers. First click nominates, second click throws. Hand-off to an adjacent team-mate is a single click.
fieldManual.rails.leftClickYourStanding: Left-click your standing player — Move is declared on the spot. Click a square to preview the route (dodge/rush rolls print on the path), click it again to commit. Right-click on grass clears the plan.
fieldManual.rails.rightClickFoulThen: Right-click → Foul, then click the victim — the 🥾 cue shows the armour target. Distant victim? First click plots the walk, second click boots. One foul per team turn.
fieldManual.rails.rightClickYourPlayer: Right-click your player → Blitz, click the enemy you’re gunning for, walk into contact, then confirm the block. Stray clicks ask before they burn the blitz. Prefer a two-click declare? Flip Declare Blitz to Modern in Settings.
fieldManual.rails.starRulesRideThe: Star rules ride the same menu as plain rows, exactly when they’re legal. Declare with a special-carrying player and a Special Ability card asks before it’s too late. If the server offers it, we surface it — nothing more.
fieldManual.rich.replays: Replays: the Replay blade (or ☰ → Load Replay File) plays any saved match through the same presentation.
fieldManual.rich.settingsLede: Six settings pages; changes preview live, Cancel rolls back, OK keeps. Three stops worth the visit:
fieldManual.rich.splashes: Splashes are skippable — click through them, or make them wait for your click in Settings → General.
fieldManual.rich.watchLive: Watch anything, live: pick FUMBBL or Super FUMBBL in the header, open Spectate, and double-click a match — or type a game id. Live spectating wants your FUMBBL login (Settings → General).
fieldManual.settingsStops.fumbblDefaultB: FUMBBL (default): blitz from the context menu. Modern: select your player, click a distant enemy, click again to commit the previewed route.
fieldManual.settingsStops.importF40kmodP: Import .f40kmod packs for skill icons, sprites and sounds — or build and export your own (PNG images, OGG/WAV/MP3 sounds).
fieldManual.settingsStops.minimumTextSiz: Minimum text size, colourblind remap, click echoes, pitch grid width and colour, brightness, UI font.
